integrity: The proof is a direct equality analysis of the published center decomposition and product formula. A separate exhaustive finite-poset replay through five points corroborates the Birkhoff-dual characterization.
limitations: Finite Heyting algebras and excluded middle only; no infinitary density equality classification is claimed. An equivalent equality observation may exist as uncatalogued folklore.
title: Equality cases for the two-thirds excluded-middle bound
